the question of how to evaluate the performance of a brand management process.
the performance of brand management and its relationship to the industry-specific relevance of brands.
the performance of the branding process and the question of whether brand management is more effective in some industries than in others.

brand management efficiency is positively influenced by brand relevance in the industry.

branding is a relevant activity for the purchase decision process.
